item.title: [Best Seller] Skintific Invisiblur All Day Loose Setting Powder Pore-Blurring Oil Control Formula for Flawless Skin
item.description:
💗SKINTIFIC Invisiblur All Day Loose Powder💗

Invisiblur All Day Loose Powder with instant perfect blur, flawless and shine-free complexion. With soft-focus polymer technology, look and feel confident from day to night with 12 hours long lasting, shine-free makeup, even without touching up. Contain powerful blend of highly crosslinked polymers and innovative hollow silica. This unique combination, featuring small particle sizes and exceptional oil absorption, creates a lightweight formula that delivers a stunning soft-focus effect. Say goodbye to shine and hello to a smooth, matte finish and oil-free, leaving your skin looking flawless and refreshed all day long. Available in shades: 01 Vanilla, 02 Ivory, 03 Petal, 03A Almond, 04 Beige, and 05 Sand for asian skin tones. 

📍Size: 10 gr

No BPOM: NA11240400057, NA11240400058, NA11240400059, NA11240400061, NA11240400060, NA11240400062, NA11240400063

📍Function: 
Flawless Skin-Perfecting Blur
All-Day Perfection
Shine-Free Confidence

📍Hero Ingredients: 
Soft-Focus Polymer Technology:  minimize pores and smoothing skin texture
Invisible Shield: Long-lasting, smudge-proof, and humidity-resistant for fresh makeup all day.
Soft and Fluffy puff with elastic mesh: give mess-free, precise, easy and even applications

📍How to Use: 
Take product as needed using the provided applicators
Apply evenly to face area 
Repeat the steps until reach the coverage and result as needed
